 Receive a Spewpa That Can Evolve into a Random Vivillon Pattern in Pokémon Legends: Z‑A 
 Which of the 16 will you get?
 Oct 29, 2026 
 Starting today, you can receive Spewpa as a Mystery Gift in Pokémon Legends: Z-A to celebrate the release of Pokémon Legends: Z-A – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Mega Dimension . Spewpa is known for evolving into Vivillon with a variety of different patterns depending on the climate and topography of the environment it was born in, but this Spewpa can evolve into one of 16 different patterns at random.
 Try seeing which pattern your Spewpa will take on after evolving into Vivillon—it will be available via Mystery Gift until Wednesday, November 18, 2026, at 5:59 p.m. PST . You can add it to your team now by following these steps:
 Open the main menu and select Link Play .
 Select Mystery Gift .
 Select Get via Internet to connect to the internet.
 Be sure to save your game.
 Please note the following:
 You will need to connect your Nintendo Switch system to the internet to claim Mystery Gifts.
 You can receive this Spewpa only once per save data. It can’t be received again.
 The user profile on your system will need to be linked to a Nintendo Account in order to connect to the internet. (This does not require a paid Nintendo Switch Online membership.)
 It takes approximately one hour of play time before you are able to access the Mystery Gift feature.
 This Mystery Gift can be received in the digital or physical versions of either Pokémon Legends: Z-A or Pokémon Legends: Z-A – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition .
 Spread Your Wings for the Vivillon Challenge!
 As Trainers around the world evolve Spewpa into Vivillon, Vivillon Points are tallied on the official Vivillon Challenge! website . If the goal of 660,000 points is reached, players will be able to receive a rare Poké Ball Pattern Vivillon to celebrate. There is no end date to this challenge, and Vivillon Points will also be earned when evolving Spewpa caught in the wild or obtained through side missions, so keep on evolving! 
 If the Vivillon Point goal is reached, the timing of the Poké Ball Pattern Vivillon distribution will be announced separately.Want to take your Vivillon into battle? Bring them over to Pokémon Champions for some memorable battles and sweet rewards. Learn more here .
